body: Observed 2026-10-14 in the V1-0285 closeout lane (PR beamfall/corvint#901, branch claude/v1-0285-closeout-evidence, BASE 495eda08c). After the lane fixed the red replay, make core-n1-replay passes against v0.8.1, rc.1 and rc.2 but coreN1Skips in cmd/corvint/core_freeze_test.go skips the cem and ocm status/verify N-1 modes (their N-1 fixture is cem/0.x, removed under decision 0525 / V1-1278), and frontier has no success golden (CEM-V1-212). title: CCF-V1-007 N-1 replay covers only 9 of 12 frozen verbs: cem, ocm skipped and frontier has no success golden
